Sebastian reached back out to me this morning requesting assistance with securing sober-living accommodations in SC. He explained that he had exhausted his financial resources and available options in Florida and was looking to return to SC.

After discussing several potential options, Sebastian asked that I reach out to Haven of Rest on his behalf to inquire about availability. I spoke with Brad, who, based on our existing relationship, agreed to accept Sebastian and confirmed that he had a bed reserved for him.

I relayed this information to Sebastian and advised him to contact Brad directly to provide an anticipated arrival date and coordinate his placement.

Spoke with Sebastian this morning. He informed me that he had traveled to Florida to visit friends and family and was offered a job while there. He decided to leave his employment with Mintz without providing notice. However, when it came time to begin the new position, he was unable to do so because he had left his identification in South Carolina.

Sebastian stated that he is still in Jacksonville, FL, and is currently seeking employment in the area. He also reported that he has completed all of his probation requirements and is simply waiting for his probation period to expire, stating that he is not in violation of any probation conditions. He agreed to keep me updated on any developments.
